sources.method: 2.5 m × 1000 = 2500 mm, from the Wii setup manual's RVL-009 row (https://www.nintendo.co.jp/wii/support/pdf/wiimanual_setup.pdf).

notes: Wii setup manual (Japan) 仕様 table: RVL-009, cord 2.5 m, about 116 g (the PDF's text layer emits the row's three labels, then its three values 'RVL-009 / 2.5m / 約116g'; the quote is the value run). It plugs into the console's AV multi-out (AVマルチ出力端子, listed among the console's rear ports). connector_a (the proprietary AV Multi Out plug) has no standard-part key; connector_b (the TV end) is not specified in the table: both null. No body envelope (dimensions_mm.states empty).
